title: Jamaican Banana Fritters
hookLine: Jamaican-inspired jamaican banana fritters with 8 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Whisk & Combine Base Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Mash bananas with fork in bowl. Keep {m53351_1}, {m53351_2}, {m53351_3}, and {m53351_4} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure banana first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Sift & Whisk Dry Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Add brown sugar, vanilla, extract, cinnamon, nutmeg and a pinch of salt. Sift in flour and stir with spoon until fully combined. Sifting aerates the dry ingredients and removes any stubborn cocoa or flour lumps so the finished crumb bakes up light and even. Incorporate {m53351_5}, {m53351_6}, {m53351_7}, and {m53351_8} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Portion, Shape & Layer Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Add oil to a 10 inch skillet over medium-high heat. Once oil is hot, drop banana fritter batter in oil by the spoonful. Once one side is golden and bubbles appear on the top, flip fritter and cook until the other side is browned as well.

steps.title: Drain Crisp, Garnish & Serve Warm
steps.instructionTemplate: Remove fritters and drain on paper towels. Enjoy. Drain briefly on a wire cooling rack lined with paper towels for 1–2 minutes so the outside stays shatteringly crisp, then plate into 4 servings and enjoy warm.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
